items.label: la veine
items.scene: A VAIN ("VEHN") moustached bodybuilder admires a blue VEIN on his flexed arm in a hand mirror.

items.label: le crâne
items.scene: A little yellow toy CRANE ("KRAHN") lowers a dinosaur fossil SKULL into a glass display case.

items.label: le squelette
items.scene: The teaching SKELETON ("skuh-LEHT") on its wheeled stand wears sunglasses and a striped scarf and waves hello.

items.label: le buste
items.scene: Two mice give a marble BUST in a woolly hat a BOOST ("BEWST") up onto its pedestal.

items.label: le muscle
items.scene: A ginger kitten MEWS ("MEWSKL") proudly as it flexes a tiny MUSCLE in a striped strongman leotard.

items.label: l'organe
items.scene: A mouse plays a little pipe ORGAN ("or-GAHN") whose pipes are shaped like body ORGANS: a heart and two lungs.

items.label: l'estomac
items.scene: A mother hippo pats her round STOMACH after lunch while her baby calls 'MA!' ("ehs-toh-MAH") for more.

items.label: le rein
items.scene: A girl RAN ("RAN") off across the floor hugging a pink bean-shaped plush KIDNEY toy.

items.label: le foie
items.scene: A bear blows one deep 'FWAH!' ("FWAH") on his tuba, and a soft plush LIVER toy sits in its bell.
